scoring_window.description: Last-hour window aggregation capturing recent degradation while preserving causality

channel_scoring.description: Core-8 channels only; auxiliary farm-specific channels (8-11) are excluded from scoring

standardization.reference_data: Normal healthy operating windows from source wind farms (Farms A and B)

temporal_persistence_gate.unanimity_property: Threshold exceedance requires continuous anomalous residuals across K=24 consecutive steps (K-of-K unanimous exceedance)
temporal_persistence_gate.instant_clearing: Clears immediately if a single 10-minute step drops below threshold, suppressing transient false alarms

alert_thresholds.percentile_calibration: Derived from source healthy normal distribution under 4-hour persistence (p95 = 2.81, p99 = 4.50)

strict_zero_shot_projection.mechanism: Zero-pad auxiliary channels 8:12 (X[:, :, 8:12] = 0.0) at test time on target turbines lacking auxiliary sensors
strict_zero_shot_projection.purpose: Eliminates 540x unpenalized ghost-sensor MSE surge without requiring target retraining
